text: 下面进入口袋 03 · 英式思维 5 把手术刀与 20 核心动词卡，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【第一刀 · 物称主语】改写：If you visit the museum, you can see local history; because of persistence, people conquer problems：
A visit to the local museum enables visitors to gain a vivid glimpse into history, and unyielding perseverance empowers individuals to conquer severe challenges.
手术刀：活动、时间、品质做主语；但感谢、道歉、承诺补救保留人称。
【二三刀 · 隐去 I think 与流水逗号】改写：I think tech makes it easy to learn, and parks climbed, it reflects investment：
It is widely acknowledged that modern technology has made it remarkably convenient to access courses, while parks climbed steadily, vividly reflecting public investment.
手术刀：锁定 make it + adj. + to do，逗号后用 doing 或 which 挂载。
【四五刀 · 免 not 与微调倒装】改写“服务不好，看似简单但只有行动能圆梦”：
The service was far from satisfactory; simple as these steps may seem, only by taking action can we turn dreams into reality.
手术刀：far from 替 not，Adj. as 与 Only by 后只提前一个 can。
